This section will focus on using machine learning techniques of classification.

## Summary

### Correction with GEE

Using the code `QA60` to get quality cloud cover bands

### Machine Learning 

Selected polygons by drawing them on the map...

Ways of supervised classification: Classification and Regression Tree (CART), RandomForest, NaiveBayes, SVM

Classes: urban_low, urban_high, water, grass, forest, bare_earth

## Reflection

Getting global administrative unit layers `ADM2_CODE` so quickly and easily in GEE.

Establishing and testing an optimal set of complementary textural data for the best possible increase in land use/cover classification accuracy ([Kupidura, 2019](https://www.mdpi.com/2072-4292/11/10/1233#)).
